name: WebMon
tagline: Interactive Web Component Picker, Resizable Desktop Widgets, Auto-Refresh & Local Auth Vault
short_description: Native macOS interactive web browser and visual DOM component selector that pins any website component as a resizable floating desktop widget with toggleable header/footer chrome (or 100% full-card edge-to-edge bleed), intermittent auto-refresh, local Keychain credential vault, and Low Effort Suite theme & Dock icon sync.
spotlight_description: WebMon v2.0 brings live web component pinning to the macOS desktop. Open any website in the built-in WebKit browser, hover and click to select one or more DOM components, and pin them as resizable, borderless Liquid Glass desktop widgets that refresh intermittently on your schedule. Add or remove widget header and footer chrome independently—or hide both so your selected web component(s) fill 100% of the HUD card edge-to-edge with a hover-only control pill. Includes persistent sign-in sessions, a local macOS Keychain credential vault (Form Auto-Fill, HTTP Basic Auth, Bearer headers, and session cookies), DOM change detection, 8-style telemetry cards, and Low Effort Suite theme & Dock icon sync across PerfMon, EventMon, VolMon, and WebMon.
catalog_description: Native macOS WebKit component clipper, resizable floating desktop widget engine, intermittent refresh scheduler, and local Keychain credential vault engineered in Swift 6. Features an interactive DOM element picker with hover bounding-box overlays, multi-component widget composition, toggleable Header & Footer chrome with 100% full-card edge-to-edge bleed when both are hidden, configurable intermittent refresh intervals (5s to 60m), persistent sign-in sessions & local Keychain auth auto-fill, 8-style HUD telemetry Cards, custom WM menu bar token builder, and Low Effort Suite theme & Dock icon sync.
spotlight_chips: Low Effort Suite Theme & Icon Sync
